CostSavingTips
Oct 2026 • Friends
Cost-saving summary: Either don't go, or go after 6:30 PM and order a set meal with fireworks. #PhuQuoc #PhuQuocFood

Runam in Sunset Town starts rushing people out at 6:30 PM. Regardless of what you ordered beforehand, you have to pay extra to see the fireworks:

1. 700,000 VND/person set meal: If you arrive early and are already full from other meals, this option is basically off.

2. 200,000 VND/person extra fee: There's nothing else included, just the entrance fee, equivalent to 50 RMB per person for the seat you've already paid.

It's not exactly expensive, but it's ridiculous for a restaurant to rush customers in specific time slots without prior notice.

Rip off
Jan 2026 • Family
0/5 Stars – Misleading Pricing and Overpriced Experience
We had a very disappointing experience at Runam in Phu Quoc and would not recommend it.
Before entering, the host clearly told us that the price would be 200,000 VND per child, including dinner. However, once we were seated inside, we were suddenly told that 200,000 VND per child was for the show only, with dinner charged separately. This was never explained upfront and felt extremely misleading.
To make matters worse, we were promised seats where we could see the show, but from our table the view was very poor and we could barely see anything at all.
Dinner itself cost 600,000 VND per person, which is wildly overpriced for Vietnam and absolutely not worth the quality or experience provided. On top of that, we were charged a 92,000 VND service fee, something that is practically unheard of in Vietnamese restaurants and was not clearly disclosed beforehand.
Overall, this felt like a tourist trap designed to confuse guests and overcharge them. We rate this restaurant 0 out of 5 stars and strongly recommend avoiding it unless you want to feel ripped off.

elegant and beautiful cafe
Nov 2023 • Solo
Ru Nam means lullaby of vietnam,i came here twice when i stayed in sunset town from 22 Nov to 24 Nov in 2023. first time i came for lunch,i ordered com ngoc bich,it is a fried rice with the broth if butterfly pea flower,so its rice is blue color,the fried rice comes with brussels sprouts,eggplant and shiitake mushroom.it is a veggies dish,very delicious and healthy.also i ordered sup nam huong ba kan vi truffle,it is shiitake mushroom soup with truffle oil,scrumptious，must try! last i ordered runam refresher, it is a mixture drinks with lime,lemongrass and mint,very refreshing. service is ok, especially a male staff,when i stepped in,he greeted me,and opened the lift for me,cuz i want to sit on the second floor. the second time i came here for dinner.this time, i ordered Com Ga Runam Dut Lo, it is RuNam signature dish,a kind of chicken rice,comes with oven baked chicken thigh and sunny side up. very tasty,the chicken thigh is flavoury, fragrance. i aslo ordered salted cream coffee and coconut ice cream as dessert, both are nice, though a bit sweet for me,but not bad.because it is end of November,the cafe already decorated with many Xmas ornaments,so the cafe looks very elegant and beautiful, dining here just like dining in a fairyland, you may hear angels singing lullabies here, haha!
